displayName: 陀螺轮蛛 Cartwheel Spider Gyro
description: Original Cartwheel Spider Gyro, a coral-and-teal biomimetic toy companion with six walking legs and two separate pusher legs. It curls its walking legs into open side arcs for a controlled quarter-roll, checks its supports, steadies a soft paper arch and makes a tiny tucked jump. An original character, not a replica or performance claim about industrial hardware.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
